title: Sad Saul
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s Bible story you will hear that 
Saul didn’t follow the Lord’s instruction 
and that made Samuel and the Lord mad & sad

King Saul DISOBEYED 
and kept the BEST sheep and cows 
THEN HE TIRED TO CONVINCE SAMUEL HE DID IT FOR THE LORD!!!!!

God wants us to OBEY Him
If we OBEY God - we LOVE Him

Let’s Play
 Ask you mom or dad to play
Simon Says
SEE HOW WELL YOU LISTEN
